name: Invitations
harvested_from: laravel-vue-template (built generic 2026-08-24; 13 of 44 local client repos hand-roll an invite flow)
description: Invite people by email and let them create their own account from a tokenised link. Tokens are hashed at rest, single-use, expiring, and re-issued on resend. Ships the admin listing, the public accept page, and a prune command.
